title: Gradings by cyclic groups on classical simple Lie algebras in prime characteristics
summary: We classify, up to isomorphism, gradings by finite cyclic groups on classical simple Lie algebras $\mathfrak{g}$ over an algebraically closed field of arbitrary characteristic. Using the smoothness of the automorphism group scheme $\operatorname{\mathbf{Aut}}\mathfrak{g}$ and correspondence between $\mathbb Z_m$-gradings and morphisms $\boldsymbolμ_m\to\operatorname{\mathbf{Aut}}\mathfrak{g}$, we express the classification as an orbit problem for certain Weyl-type groups.
